column1: # SBC-GS configuration registry: the single source of truth for every tunable key (docs/CONFIG.md).
# TAB-separated, 10 fields, no empty field ('~' = empty default, '-' = none):
# type: int|float|port|ip|path|bool|str|enum:a|b (suffix ? = empty allowed). SAFETY keys: min/max are HARD bounds that
# no layer may exceed without --i-know / SBC_GS_I_KNOW=1. env '-' = SBC_GS_<KEY>, otherwise the exact environment variable name.
